feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Invading armies, subterfuge and conquest: How fire ant wars affect ecosystems
entry.summary: Ants disperse seeds, scavenge, turn soil and serve as a food source in their ecosystems. If local ants are displaced by invasive ants from elsewhere, the effects are widely felt.

entry.title: This seven-course dinner of airline food featured caviar and kangaroo soup
entry.summary: At Seattle's Museum of Flight, 150 guests enjoyed a seven-course seated dinner of airline food through the ages.

entry.title: Federal judges in Colorado are fed up with ICE re-arresting the same immigrants
entry.summary: A federal judge in Colorado has found ICE in contempt for ignoring court orders to not immediately re-arrest detainees they've ordered released.

entry.title: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing
entry.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.

entry.title: Democratic sweep doubles their number of vets in Congress
entry.summary: The incoming 120th Congress will be made up of at least 80 military veterans, including more female vets than ever. Political parties recruit veterans to run in tough races.

entry.title: Ex-White House AI advisor weighs in on national security as Huang is back as Nvidia CEO
entry.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back in leadership after resigning recently. Ben Buchanan, a Biden administration AI adviser, discusses what that means for the U.S. national security and chip exports.

entry.title: NPR staff's 2026 picks for Books We Love
entry.summary: NPR's annual books recommendation engine, Books We Love, is out now. Scott Detrow speaks with NPR's Andrew Limbong about staff picks.

entry.title: They attended Trump's controversial meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
entry.summary: Trump held another meme coin dinner for top holders of his cryptocurrency — an event that has raised intense controversy. Here's an inside account from two guests who attended.

entry.title: Virginia, Oregon sue Elon Musk's SpaceXSI over deepfake nonconsensual sexual images
entry.summary: The attorney generals of Oregon and Virginia are suing Elon Musk's AI company for allowing its users to make nonconsensual sexualized images of real people using chatbot Grok.

entry.title: Chicago now has the worst traffic in the U.S. — here's why
entry.summary: Chicago takes the top ranking for traffic jams according to a pair of new analyses, and according to its many, many frustrated drivers who waste hours of their lives stuck in them.
